title: Happy Anniversary My Beautiful Love 💖
message: One year ago, I was the luckiest person alive because I had you by my side. Every moment with you has been a blessing, and I cherish every memory we've created together. Here's to many more years of love, laughter, and happiness. I love you more than words can express. Happy Anniversary, my beautiful love! 💖

timeline.title: Love at First Sight
timeline.description: The moment I saw you in bus, I knew you were the one. Your smile lit up the entire bus, and I couldn't take my eyes off you.

timeline.title: Our First Gamezone Date
timeline.description: Our first and the most memorable date at Gamezone. We had so much fun playing games and sharing laughs. It was the perfect start to our beautiful journey together.

timeline.title: The Proposal at Ginger
timeline.description: The place where we had romed first time and where I proposed to you. It was a magical moment that I will cherish forever.

timeline.title: Marriage
timeline.description: Not that much big but it was the best, most memorable day of my life. I am so grateful to have you as my partner, and I look forward to spending the rest of my life with you.

timeline.title: Home Entry
timeline.description: It was a challenging day for both of us, but we made it through together.
